title: MONO Volume Two
print_run: 1000 per Gomma and Anzenberger listings; colophon of a copy shows 220/950

description.main: The second volume of Gomma Books' MONO series of contemporary black-and-white photography, with work by 26 photographers and Daido Moriyama as special guest.
description.extended:
MONO Volume Two is the second hardback in Gomma Books' MONO series, a survey of contemporary black-and-white photography by 26 photographers.

The 256-page volume, printed in duotone on Fedrigoni paper in Italy, includes Matt Black, Martin Bogren, Dirk Braeckman, Giacomo Brunelli, Lorenzo Castore, Eamonn Doyle, JH Engström, Sohrab Hura, Paulo Nozolino, Magdalena Switek, Scott Typaldos and Miron Zownir, with Daido Moriyama as special guest. Christian Caujolle, Ilgin Deniz Akseloglu and Peggy Sue Amison contribute texts. It is bound in black cloth with silver hot-stamped titles and was issued in a numbered limited edition after a Kickstarter campaign.

MONO is independently produced by Gomma Books, edited by Luca Desienna, and the series is presented as a trilogy devoted to black-and-white work.
